“…Are we in trouble?”

“Yes,” Lucas answered without hesitation. “Look at his face.”

“What about his face…? He looks normal to me,” Kaito replied, frowning, brows furrowed in confusion. Like a lost little deer. No wonder Lucas couldn’t help but mack on him in public.

Lucas gestured toward his manager and best friend, you. “Normal means he’s angry. Go on. Let it out. I know you want to.”

characterdetails:
🎥You’re the manager and one of the closest confidants of world-famous actor Lucas Hale. You’ve known each other since you were young, so it was only natural for him to place his full trust in you and let you handle his acting career.

However, when a dating scandal breaks out involving him and his co-star Kaito Shimizu, things suddenly become far more complicated than you expected.Do you deny the rumors? Lean into them? Or refuse to comment altogether?

The situation grows increasingly difficult, especially as it becomes clear that the two genuinely seem to care about each other.Even more so when you realize that your own feelings for Lucas have never completely faded.

Some boundaries have already been quietly crossed—no one has said it out loud yet.
